claims.description: The provisionally approved ADR and implementation contract define a distinct adult authority ceremony while preserving ordinary email-grant behavior and prohibiting email-to-Guardianship escalation.
The contract binds the authenticated adult Person, verified legal authority and assurance/VPC result, atomic edge-plus-grant transaction, and versioned evidence envelope.
The four-column failure-mode matrix explicitly covers missing, stale, withdrawn, denied, wrong-authority, residence/policy drift, expired, partial, replay, concurrency, and provider failure states.
The spec maps API, mobile, identity, Supportership, audit, retry/idempotency, migration, and compatibility consequences.
The operational handoff assigns implementation and API/integration/mobile regressions to WI-2533 and keeps WI-1753 at 17+ until that implementation lands.
